reason: Official ZOZO data documentation and the Open Bandit Pipeline executable loader clarify raw-file versus internal indexing before any empirical policy-value result is produced.

position.v0_1: position = 1 was described as the leftmost recommendation position
position.v0_2: This remains correct for the raw OBD files: raw positions 1, 2 and 3 are left, center and right. OpenBanditDataset subsequently dense-ranks those labels and subtracts one, so the leftmost slot is internal position 0 after loader normalization.
position.primary_filter: For direct raw-file ingestion, filter raw position == 1. For data emitted by OpenBanditDataset, filter normalized position == 0.

action_count.v0_2: The official ZOZO data description confirms all-campaign item IDs 0 through 80, hence 81 nominal actions. The source audit must still verify that the retrieved archive matches this contract before OPE runs.
action_count.primary_contract: observed action IDs and item-context IDs must jointly cover exactly 0 through 80

propensity_field.v0_2: propensity_score is confirmed as the raw executable field and is loaded as pscore by OpenBanditDataset. A legacy action_prob alias may be detected and reported only for explicit compatibility diagnostics; it must never be silently preferred over propensity_score.

unchanged: random reference restricted to the BTS evaluation time window
outcome_visibility: No Open Bandit Dataset CTR, reward mean, OPE estimate, challenger value, ranking, or promotion result was inspected to make this clarification.
